issues.description: Packet assembler supplies pinned source identities under revision and git_blob_sha. The frozen v0.4 checker recognizes revision_id or blob_sha for pinned_revision documentary claims. Source identities and dates remain available to coders but this check can fail mechanically.
issues.origin: Coordinator packet/checker integration mismatch, not a new substantive criterion.
issues.response: Do not modify frozen packets, checker, or outputs during coding. Retain original failure. After freeze, a separately labeled metadata-alias diagnostic may test whether the failure is solely field naming. Never report that diagnostic as an original workflow pass.

post_freeze_diagnostic.remaining_alias_only_error: F01_v04_r2 U25 cites pinned commit metadata with exact SHA in serialized source text, but no top-level revision field.
